messages.snippet: Dear Subscriber, Our Q1 2026 Central London Offices report is now available. Prime City office yield
messages.subject: Q1 2026 Central London Offices — yields and rental trends
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Subscriber,

Our Q1 2026 Central London Offices report is now available. Prime City office yields held at 5.25% with secondary stock softening to 6.5–7.0%. Take-up was up 8% quarter on quarter, led by the EC1/Clerkenwell submarket. Download the full report and book a demo of our portfolio analytics platform via the link below.

PropIndex Research — independent commercial property data.
